prior_definitions.uniform-area: Equal physical area for the equal square cells.
prior_definitions.uniform-solid-angle: Exact solid angle of each square cell seen from detector (0, 0, 0) mm.

heldout.score_definition: For every held-out trigger, compare the natural logs of the existing event angular response averaged under the matching training map and the prior alone. The distributions span the whole wide grid, and each average includes the same unresolved response term.
heldout.interpretation: Positive values indicate better average held-out angular agreement than the matching prior. The score is conditional on the saved response model and does not measure localization accuracy or a calibrated likelihood of the detector data.

three_intersection_diagnostic.subgroup_definition: Energy-compatible measured trigger with exactly three saved native endpoint intersections.
three_intersection_diagnostic.interpretation: The labels use simulated endpoints. The measured cone geometry and saved order masses are fixed. Each order uses the original prior normalization on the entire selected footprint. Diagnostic maps keep those weights without renormalizing by group. The bound prior study contains the full grids; subtract subgroup_mass to recover the remainder.

ancestry_method.absence_of_ge_deposition: A sibling root with zero Ge deposition has no inferred escape or scatter path.
ancestry_method.birth_anchor: Same nearest photon and exact charged-child birth position, decay-relative time and process.
ancestry_method.collection_energy: Sum Ge input rows by native terminal electron and hole contacts in the same row.
ancestry_method.direct_gamma_deposits: Keep the photon ancestry and collection cell. Leave child-birth attribution unassigned.
ancestry_method.photon_birth_energy: Radioactive-decay track birth. The root-family Ge sum tests accounting against birth energy.

readout_method.positions: Saved center-template XYZ. Each cone stores its first site directly; its second is recovered from the saved axis and separation. XY is fixed at strip centers.
readout_method.residual: Angle between back-projection axis and direction from vertex to programmed Co position minus the energy-derived cone half-angle, in degrees. The programmed positions are used only after the original fits, pairings and order masses are fixed.
readout_method.energy: Measured site energy averages the two slow strip energies. The ideal diagnostics sum simulated deposited energy by endpoint intersection and independently by face. One selected endpoint therefore contributes half its deposit to the ideal site-energy average.
readout_method.scope: Four selected trigger occurrences from two archived simulated histories. The cones are conditional on a fully absorbed photon modeled with two measured sites.

photon_path.definition: Each row is a scored Ge chord of the depositing primary photon. Its local STEP deposition excludes energy deposited by descendants. Turns use contiguous chords. The Ge STEP table does not record incident kinetic energy.
